why: the cloud-forest belt clings to the massif through the day, thick in rain, clear on settled days (climatology §2 altitude, §4; 55 §97)
radiation mist forms on clear calm nights over wet ground and burns off after dawn (climatology §2; the day's sunrise ends 07:00, the mist two hours later)
advection fog rolls in overnight on the sea breeze's reversal and lifts by late morning (climatology §2, §3 exp(-dCoast/8))
